title: SleepyVote
description: 😴 Click-to-vote night skip with auto bed trigger and clean multiplayer flow.
body:
# 😴 SleepyVote

SleepyVote adds a polished night-skip vote flow with clickable chat buttons and configurable thresholds.

## ✨ Features
- Clickable **YES / NO** buttons in chat
- Manual vote start with `/sleepyvote start`
- Optional auto-start on bed entry
- Configurable required percentage and minimum players
- Per-world safe handling

## ⚙️ Commands
- `/sleepyvote start`
- `/sleepyvote yes`
- `/sleepyvote no`
- `/sleepyvote status`
- `/sleepyvote stop`
- `/sleepyvote reload`

## 🔐 Permissions
- `sleepyvote.use`
- `sleepyvote.start`
- `sleepyvote.admin`

## ✅ Requirements
- Java 17+
- Paper/Spigot/Purpur/Folia
- Minecraft 1.20.4+

## ☕ Support
- [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/perusi)
